Name: NyanKart
Author: St0l3nID
Description:
[size=4][b]NyanKart[/b][/size]

I made this for my stream a year ago, i put some work in to auto-mute and restart the Background music of your game, and now its release ready. It very effectivly increases your PPM (pain per minute).

The rainbow trail renders over everything, unfortunatly SMAPI doesnt seem to expose a render step before foreground elements or  the black border around it, yet again, if you actually considering doing this to yourself... would really want this mod to render perfectly fine?
